question: As of August, 2023, which of the following states has India’s first fully functionally literate district?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh **tribal-dominated** Mandla** district became the first fully "functionally literate" district in the country in August 2023.
 
• This milestone was achieved through extensive educational initiatives and community participation aimed at improving literacy rates.
